body:
FORKS/GATES FOR DELIVERY ATTACK:
1) Public launch: A separate-domain Stage requiring its own fullscreen click vs a neutral public-domain launcher that becomes Stage and opens private Console. Gate: real Win extended-screen prototype proving exact gesture/permission/popup flow while scanning public origin HTTP/WSS/DOM/SW/cache for private canary zero bytes. Choose before frontend routing/auth/SW.
2) Session topology: one logical session coordinator exposed through two role BFFs vs physically separate private authority + public projection service/store. My minimum is distinct deployables/credentials/topics and closed schemas even if same repo/database cluster. Gate: display credential/topic cannot reach private canary under API, WSS subscription, cache, logs, errors, timing/size probes.
3) Mirror bootstrap: existing Console pairs phone before mirroring vs phone-first controller that binds a guest public PC. Gate: cold-start rehearsal from no credentials on presentation PC, including controller loss/takeover, with no instant where private UI is projected.
4) Ingestion artifact: structural extraction and LibreOffice render must converge into one versioned canonical bundle whose slide IDs drive viewer, STT fusion, RAG anchors, offline cache, public stage. Gate on 3 representative Korean PPTX/PDF decks: stable IDs after re-upload rules documented, render fidelity accepted, no missing-font/chart blocker.
5) AI/public release: private candidate pipeline first; public live web publishing remains feature-flagged until measured. Gate: Korean corpus p95 <=5s eligible recommendations plus false-SUPPORT threshold and approval usability, with ACL revoke/rights/privacy fail-closed.
6) WSS command semantics: define PublicPresentationState vs PrivatePresenterState projections before UI. Gate via deterministic duplicate/out-of-order/gap/reconnect/controllerEpoch property tests and two-device live run. Challenge prototype/staffing/order aggressively.
